caption:
I build software and 3D print the hardware it runs in. Kojo Labs is where all of it gets documented.

A talking Destiny Ghost. A satellite sim checked against the textbook to 1 meter. A little animated face for my Raspberry Pi. An AI that writes performance and award statements.

Follow along. Every build gets broken down here, with the code and the print files.
